name: CSR+ (single-disc)
blurb: CutScenes Removed + scene trims (Hojo, Aerith house, City of the Ancients, endgame), collapsed onto one Disc 1 image. Ask-menu removed, Supernova granted. Ending/credits movies ship separately; other non-ending movies are not preserved.
betaNote: Single-disc is still playtesting; known freezes and glitches on some paths. Non-ending movies may show the wrong clip or glitch -- this is expected.
